From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: MAP initiation — Private VPC/on‑prem: introduce owners, confirm topology & schedule

Hi Mike / Ana —

Thanks for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m kicking off the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the Hearth Financial private deployment (deal HW-2026-046). Goal here is to align owners, confirm the proposed topology (VPC + VPN peering vs on‑prem appliance), and lock a technical evaluation window so we can target an end-of-July close.

Short ask for this thread: please confirm the people on your side who will own network connectivity (VPN/firewall), IAM/KMS decisions, and the compliance/security review. On our side I’ve looped in the folks who will own those areas. I’ve attached a starter MAP workbook and a first-pass network topology draft.

Key items and suggested owners (please update):
- Network / VPN / Firewall: Hearth point of contact (external) — please confirm; Redwood: Dev Patel (technical lead)
- IAM / KMS / key management: Hearth security contact — please confirm; Redwood: Soojin Lee (security lead)
- Deployment topology decisions (on‑prem appliance vs VPC peering): Redwood product & infra: Marissa Cole (product lead), Evelyn Hart (solutions)
- Contract & commercial: me (karthik) and Marissa for any SLAs/credits

Suggested near-term timeline:
1) This week (Jul 1–3): stakeholder roster & technical constraints confirmed
2) Week of Jul 6: technical evaluation (2–3 day window) with our infra engineers and your network team
3) Week of Jul 13: security/compliance review, KMS proof-of-concept and sample audit evidence exchange
4) End of July: target decision & commercial close

Attachments: Hearth_MAP_v1.xlsx, network_topology_draft.pdf, kms_owners_list.csv (starter)

Next steps (please reply inline):
- Mike / Ana: confirm network and security owners and any blackout windows for your infra team
- Internal: Dev / Soojin / Marissa — if anything missing in the above owner assignments, flag now

Thanks — happy to set a 30‑minute MAP kickoff call if helpful.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0117

Karthik — thanks for the quick summary and the docs. We’re excited to move forward. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Network / VPN / Firewall owner: Mike Chen (me) for contract side, but technical owner will be Ana Rodrigues (Infra Partners — our external integrator) — Ana will lead the VPN tunnel build and firewall rules
- IAM / KMS owner: Laura Mills (security lead at Hearth Financial) — she’ll own KMS policy and key rotation questions
- Compliance reviewer: I’ll loop our internal compliance lead if necessary once we have the SCP/scope

Timing: the week of Jul 6 should work for a controlled evaluation, but Ana has a partial blackout July 7 (on-call rotation). We can do Jul 6 or Jul 8 as alternatives.

We’ll review the MAP workbook and get back with updated owner contact details and a short discovery note by end of day Jul 2.

Regards,

Hearth Financial

Hi Ana / Mike —

Thanks for confirming ownership. A couple of quick tech clarifications so we can size the evaluation correctly: 
1) VPN topology: do you prefer an IPsec site-to-site tunnel terminates to our managed VPC (we provide a public IP / ASN), or will you bring a transitive on‑prem appliance and peer privately? The attached draft assumes site-to-site to a Redwood VPC with controlled ingress rules.
2) Egress and data residency: any constraints on egress to third‑party telemetry endpoints (we default to no external callouts during evaluation unless explicitly allowed).
3) KMS: do you have an existing HSM-backed KMS cluster (AWS/GCP/Azure Key Vault or on‑prem HSM) we should integrate with, or will you evaluate Redwood-managed envelope encryption first?

If you can reply with short answers and a preferred date (Jul 6 or Jul 8) I’ll reserve the infra slots and prepare a checklist for the evaluation windows (VPN credentials, test instance IPs, firewall rule templates, sample keys).

Attached: network_topology_draft.pdf

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Staff Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick operational notes from Redwood Product / Solutions: 
- We’ll plan a 48–72 hour evaluation slot starting Jul 6 (preferred) or Jul 8 if Ana needs the 7th blocked out. Dev — please confirm infra availability and share the checklist you mentioned by EOD Jul 3.
- Soojin: please prep the KMS integration doc and a short matrix of what evidence we can supply for their compliance team (SOC2 artifacts, key rotation logs, audit trail snippets).
- Evelyn: I’ll need a short one‑pager that maps the expected user flows + failure modes for the on‑prem appliance option; that will help their security and network teams evaluate impact quickly.

Marissa will own tracking acceptance criteria in the MAP workbook — I’ll add the timeline in the shared Drive link. Karthik — once we have the confirmed owners and date, can you open a HubSpot milestone for the evaluation?
